pages.name: QGA: 4.Nc3 c5 5.d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave an impossible f4-f5 (knight on f3, pawn on e2); rewrote it around e4, Bxc4 and e5. British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: 4.Nc3 c5 5.d5 e6 6.e4
pages.notes: Overview missed that Black is two pawns up for development; plan 1 supported e5 with f4 behind the f3-knight; plan 2 routed the d7-knight via f8 where the bishop stands. Rewrote all.

pages.name: QGA: 4.Nc3 e6 5.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...g5 with White's bishop on g5; plan 3 pressed a d5-pawn that is not there. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Bogoljubow, 7.a4 Nxc3
pages.notes: Plan 1 offered both Be2 and g3/Bg2 and a d4-d5 push into the d5-queen. Rewrote it (Bg2 against d5 and a8, axb5); British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Bogoljubow, 7.a4 Nxc3
pages.notes: Overview kept a knight on d5 after it was traded on c3; plan 1 said Be3 or Ba3 challenge the d5-queen. Rewrote overview sentence and plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Bogoljubow Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave an a5 break with the pawn on a2; rewrote it (e5, a4 against ...b5). British spelling, including Defence.

pages.name: QGA: Flohr, 5.Nc3 c6
pages.notes: Plan 1 proposed a minority attack; plan 2 played ...c6 again and ...e6 and ...Bd6 with the bishop on e6. Rewrote both.

pages.name: QGA: Janowski-Larsen, 5.h3
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a semi-open g-file that only exists after gxf3; plan 3 wrote g4 as an immediate White move. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Janowski-Larsen, 6.h3
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d5 into the e6-pawn; rewrote it around e3-e4 and the g-pawn caveat. British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: Janowski-Larsen, 6.h3 Bh5 7.Nc3 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed the c4-bishop to e2 and pushed d5; plan 2 sent the h5-bishop to b7 via ...b6. Rewrote both; British spelling.
